verdict.rationale: Mercury's bill pay supports multi-layered approval rules, with approvals inside Slack or the mobile app, and it detects duplicate bills, which implies bills are entered into the system. The Books launch post says bill pay transactions flow into the ledger automatically. However, the evidence never explicitly describes how vendor bills are captured or how payments are scheduled, so the single end-to-end workflow is only partly shown. Missing for 10: explicit bill capture method (upload, email-in or OCR), documented payment scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
